text:
omar: Quick sync — proposing a 'queue saturation heatmap' for runtime + infra dashboards to surface hotspots by model/region/route. Need inputs: continuous batch-size distribution, time-in-queue percentiles (p50/p95/p99), active queue depth, and pod/GPU saturation indicators.

helen: +1. For runtime metrics we need: batch_size_hist, batch_wait_ms_hist, and a counter for fast-path single-token responses. Important labels: model, model_version (major), region, route (see cardinality note), and priority.

jessica: Can infra provide pod-level signals: gpu_util_pct, pod_queue_len, node_cpu_pressure, and preempt_count? Also require node labels: zone, instance_type.

liam: From runtime: we already emit continuous_batch_size_hist and queue_wait_ms_bucket but labels today are only {model, host}. We can add region and priority, but adding route for every request will blow up cardinality.

omar: Yup — cardinality is the killer. Proposal: only include route label for top N routes (by QPS) and fallback to route="other" for the rest. For model_version, emit major version (e.g. v2) not full commit hash.

helen: Also want two rollups: per-route 1h heatmap for product owners, and per-cluster 5m heatmap for SRE/alerts. Heatmaps should allow selecting metric (p50/p95 wait, avg batch size, queue depth).

jessica: Dashboard UX idea: heatmap keyed by (model, region) with color = p95 queue wait, and overlay saturation threshold lines for gpu_util>85% and queue_depth>100. Click cell -> time-series + sample traces.

liam: Example PromQL for p95 wait (5m rate):
```promql
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le, model, region) (rate(queue_wait_ms_bucket[5m]))) / 1000
```
That returns p95 wait in seconds if we divide by 1000. For batch size distribution: use sum by (le, model, region) (rate(batch_size_bucket[5m])).

helen: Suggest an alert: sustained p95 queue_wait > 0.5s for 10m AND cluster_gpu_util > 85% for 5m -> page oncall. Also lower-priority ticket if queue_depth spikes but GPUs are <70% (workload imbalance).

infra-bot: FYI estimated cost impact: metrics_ingest +3% for adding extra labels and histograms. Suggest sampling route label and using rollups to limit cardinality.

deploy-bot: Canary started: runtime-agent v2.14 -> prod-canary nodes (canary group 3). Logs: https://ci.internal/deploys/1769 :rocket:

jessica: Console UX: add a "Heatmap" tile with time-range selector, model filter, and a toggle between p95 wait / avg batch size / saturation overlays. Include a small popover showing which metrics are runtime vs infra. Link to PerfTracer for traces.

liam: I'll draft a short RFC and open PRs: runtime metric changes (agent) + Grafana dashboard JSON + alert rules. ETA: EOD Thu. I'll prototype queries with limited labels to test ingestion.

omar: Action items:
- liam: RFC + PRs (runtime metrics + grafana)
- infra: add pod_gpu_util, pod_queue_len, node labels to exporter
- helen: design heatmap layout + alert thresholds
- jessica: Console tile spec + sample payload for Console team
Schedule: 30m sync Thu 11:00am. Thanks all :thumbsup:
